title: Avoid type-fest OverrideProperties for recursive TypeScript types
answers: Why do inherited fields disappear from a recursive route/tree type?
TypeScript says a property doesn't exist on a recursive interface built with OverrideProperties
How to type a self-referential structure like a route tree with overridden child fields
Route type loses inherited RoutingTreeRoute fields
body:
Symptom: a recursive type built with type-fest's OverrideProperties<Base, {child: Self[]}> silently loses visibility of inherited base fields in TypeScript (consumers can't see fields from the base type).
Root cause: mapped-type utilities like OverrideProperties don't resolve well when one of the overridden properties references the type being defined (self-reference inside the mapped type), per packages/grafana-alerting/src/grafana/notificationPolicies/types.ts:Route.
Fix pattern: define the type as `interface X extends Omit<Base, 'recursiveKey' | 'otherOverriddenKeys'> { recursiveKey: X[]; otherOverriddenKeys: ... }` — keep the recursive/overridden fields out of any mapped-type utility and add them directly on an interface extending Omit<Base, ...>.
Constraints: applies whenever a type recursively references itself through one of its own overridden properties; not needed for non-recursive overrides, where OverrideProperties remains fine.
applies: TypeScript type definitions for recursive/self-referential structures (e.g. tree-shaped domain types) anywhere in the grafana packages.

Custom recursive type loses inherited properties from the base interface
search: Type-fest's OverrideProperties utility loses visibility of inherited base fields when the overridden property is self-referential, breaking recursive type definitions. Use interface extending Omit<Base, 'recursiveKey'> with the recursive property defined directly instead of through the mapped-type utility. Applies to recursive/tree-shaped type definitions like Route in packages/grafana-alerting/src/grafana/notificationPolicies/types.ts where self-referential overrides are needed. Non-recursive OverrideProperties usage remains fine and unaffected by this constraint.
